title: Please join me in presenting Legislative Resolution No. 235-38 (COR), relative to recognizing December 1, 2026, as “GivingTuesday Guam”; and commending KUAM CareForce, its Spark Ambassadors, and the island’s nonprofit organizations, businesses, community partners, and volunteers for their continued commitment to generosity, philanthrophy, and community service throughout Guam.
